narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Create content/patterns/operator-log-hygiene.md with the six failure modes, anti-patterns, positive rules, thin non-goals, and SLizard as external reference only.

3. Optional: add a consumer pack stub under content/packs or docs with Taskfile target name + validator skeleton comments; wire docs only — not framework deft check.
4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for #1940; content-contract pins if required; verify with content tests or rg pin checks.
5. Update issue #1940 current-shape comment to pass-2 shipped with PR link via REST; close #1940.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer operator building a service with operator-facing logs, I want Deft guidance and a checklist at story/probe time, so that I do not reinvent SLizard-class hygiene under production fire.

items.title: Pattern/lesson content with failure modes and anti-patterns

narrative.Acceptance: Given content/patterns/operator-log-hygiene.md exists, when an agent opens it, then it lists the six case-study failure modes, anti-patterns, positive rules, explicit non-goals (no core schema, no default-on, not Insights/LLM telemetry), and cites SLizard only as an external reference path/issue pointer.

Given REFERENCES.md and content/docs/operator-log-hygiene-checklist.md, when searching for operator log or observability keywords, then the checklist path is discoverable and the checklist is copy-paste usable for story AC or probe locked decisions.
